A targeting viewfinder with a reticle.
A red structure rises from the desert.

context.scene_title: Surveillance/scope view of a large structure rising from the desert — likely a monitored sighting tied to the Garden conflict (Disc 2).
locations: A targeting/monitor display (reticle frame and a running counter) showing a red multi-part structure emerging from a desert in a cloud of dust

characters.name: (none)
characters.recognition: Shown only as monitor footage; no characters visible.

context.summary: Through a camera/targeting viewfinder — complete with a framing reticle and a ticking numeric counter — a large red structure is seen rising from the desert amid billowing dust, as if being tracked on a surveillance or scope display.
context.context_note: Identity uncertain: the red structure on the monitor could be Galbadia Garden mobilizing or a replay of the D-District Prison; recorded as a best-guess surveillance view.
